title: The CZ CryoET Data Portal: Enabling Collaborative Analysis of Standardized CryoET Data using Machine Learning Methods
content: Recent advances in sample preparation techniques [1,2], automated data collection [3] and live processing methods have accelerated cryo-electron tomography (cryoET), allowing researchers to routinely collect and share datasets comprising hundreds to thousands of tomograms [4,5]. While these large datasets offer unique opportunities for analysis of cellular organization at scale, their annotation using traditional approaches has become practically infeasible, often requiring months of expert curation for even moderately sized datasets.
